title: Gate relation
statement: Let $C$ be a Boolean circuit on $n$ input variables, let $i$ be one of its gate positions, and assign a sign in $\{ -1,1\}$ to each input and gate coordinate. The gate relation at $i$ holds when the Boolean value represented by the sign at gate $i$ equals the value computed by that gate: the corresponding input bit, its constant value, the negation of its earlier source gate, the conjunction of its two earlier source gates, or the disjunction of its two earlier source gates.
hypotheses_covered: A natural number $n$ of input variables
A sign assignment to all $n$ input and $C$'s gate coordinates
